positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
o Created an Emergency Application in Android that includes features like reporting emergency situations, a newsfeed of latest emergency news, chat screen, and a map with markers of all the emergency situations

o App also includes searching, filtering and push notifications

projects.title: MyWeatherApp
projects.description:
An Android Application which provides the information regarding  Weather conditions for current city and  Cities added by users for current time as well as next 24 hours.
It also provides the highest temperature, lowest temperature and weather status too.
